All 4 models vs. their real targets

Each model's real final feature list (read from its own *_feature_importance.csv) against the actual target it was trained to predict, computed from rfp_training_data_complete_v3.csv under that model's own training filter — not one dataset reused across all four. Correlation is Pearson r for continuous/categorical features and point-biserial r for binary flags (same formula, correct name for a 0/1 side) — shown alongside Spearman ρ.
